Day 20 anomaly demands immediate segregation and forensic review before I take new measurements. My action items from day 20 conclusion were explicit: (1) segregate days 11–19 vs day 20 data and recalculate statistics; (2) verify day-20 raw event logs against my notebook; (3) check for day-20-specific maintenance or environmental alerts; (4) if day 20 is confirmed anomalous, recompute cross-correlations on days 11–19 alone. I must complete the day-20 forensics now, while memory and records are fresh, before proceeding to Day 21 measurements.
